text: The keyWizard.js, keyWizard.xhtml and keyWizard.css family keeps the lowerCamel file stem. In this dialog, control IDs such as passwordConfirm are lowerCamel, reusable classes such as wizard-section and input-container are dashed, and Fluent IDs use the openpgp- prefix with dashes. Follow the existing role-specific names for additions to this family. Historical in-subdialog was a temporary sizing class and is absent from the current stylesheet. This is a scoped naming recommendation, not a rule for all Thunderbird dialogs. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Extend OpenPGP wizard names according to their local role
